title: Ley N° 7190/23, De los Créditos de Carbono
evidence: BACN page (opened 2026-11-03) states "Fecha de Promulgación: 12-10-2023" and "Fecha de Publicación: 12-10-2023"; the text has no commencement clause (art. 26 is "Comuníquese al Poder Ejecutivo"), so Código Civil (Ley 1183/85) art. 1, read on BACN (https://www.bacn.gov.py/leyes-paraguayas/5293/codi-) on 2026-11-03: "Las leyes son obligatorias en todo el territorio de la República desde el día siguiente al de su publicación, o desde el día que ellas determinen."
notes: Record is the whole law as published. Establishes ownership of carbon credits by the project holder (art. 3), makes MADES the authority (art. 5) and requires registration of projects and transfers in the Registro de los Créditos de Carbono (art. 24 gives existing projects one year from publication to register). A carbon-market duty, not a general emissions-reporting rule. Art. 25 required the Executive to regulate it within 180 days; the regulation is py-decreto-3369-2025 (signed 2025-02-18, well after that term). Spanish only: the BACN page serves no Guaraní text, and no government English text was found on the BACN law page or the MADES laws list.

title: Ley N° 5875/2017, Nacional de Cambio Climático
evidence: BACN page (opened 2026-11-03) states "Fecha de Promulgación: 15-09-2017" and "Fecha de Publicación: 27-09-2017"; the text has no commencement clause (art. 19 is "Comuníquese al Poder Ejecutivo"), so Código Civil (Ley 1183/85) art. 1, read on BACN (https://www.bacn.gov.py/leyes-paraguayas/5293/codi-) on 2026-11-03: "Las leyes son obligatorias en todo el territorio de la República desde el día siguiente al de su publicación, o desde el día que ellas determinen."
notes: Climate framework act: sets the framework to plan and respond to climate change (art. 1), creates the Comisión Nacional de Cambio Climático and the Dirección Nacional de Cambio Climático. Duties fall on the State; it lays no emissions-reporting duty on companies. The reglamento named in the brief (Decreto 7177/2017) was not found on any official page opened and no source seen confirms that number, so it has no entry; Ley 5875 art. 18 refers to the earlier Decreto 14943/2001, which MADES lists (https://www.mades.gov.py/decretos) and which is not in scope here. MADES re-hosts the Gaceta scan of this law, which has no text layer. Spanish only: the BACN page serves no Guaraní text, and no government English text was found on the BACN law page or the MADES laws list.

title: Ley N° 294/93, De Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
evidence: BACN page (opened 2026-11-03) states "Fecha de Promulgación: 14-12-1993" and "Fecha de Publicación: 31-12-1993"; the text has no commencement clause (art. 15 is "Comuníquese al Poder Ejecutivo"), so Código Civil (Ley 1183/85) art. 1, read on BACN (https://www.bacn.gov.py/leyes-paraguayas/5293/codi-) on 2026-11-03: "Las leyes son obligatorias en todo el territorio de la República desde el día siguiente al de su publicación, o desde el día que ellas determinen."
notes: Makes an environmental impact assessment obligatory (art. 1) for the project types in art. 7 and ties the start of works to the Declaración de Impacto Ambiental. Record is the law as published; the amendment by Ley 345/1994 is a separate law on BACN that was not stored (not an ESG-specific act). Regulated by Decreto 453/2013 (py-decreto-453-2013). Spanish only: the BACN page serves no Guaraní text, and no government English text was found on the BACN law page or the MADES laws list.

title: Ley N° 1561/2000, que crea el Sistema Nacional del Ambiente, el Consejo Nacional del Ambiente y la Secretaría del Ambiente
evidence: BACN page (opened 2026-11-03) states "Fecha de Promulgación: 21-07-2000" and "Fecha de Publicación: 24-07-2000"; the text has no commencement clause (art. 40 is "Comuníquese al Poder Ejecutivo"), so Código Civil (Ley 1183/85) art. 1, read on BACN (https://www.bacn.gov.py/leyes-paraguayas/5293/codi-) on 2026-11-03: "Las leyes son obligatorias en todo el territorio de la República desde el día siguiente al de su publicación, o desde el día que ellas determinen."
notes: Creates SISNAM, CONAM and the Secretaría del Ambiente (SEAM). Institutional act: it binds public bodies, not companies. The Secretaría became the Ministerio del Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible by Ley 6123/2018 (MADES lists the PDF at https://www.mades.gov.py/leyes); that amending law is not stored. Spanish only: the BACN page serves no Guaraní text, and no government English text was found on the BACN law page or the MADES laws list.

title: Ley N° 1334/98, De Defensa del Consumidor y del Usuario
evidence: BACN page (opened 2026-11-03) states "Fecha de Promulgación: 27-10-1998" and "Fecha de Publicación: 30-10-1998"; art. 53: "La presente ley entrará en vigencia a los ciento ochenta días de su promulgación." 180 days after 1998-10-27 is 1999-04-25 (counting the promulgation day as day 0; a count that starts the next day gives 1999-04-26)
notes: Umbrella consumer law used for misleading advertising, which is the hook for environmental claims; it has no environmental-claims provision of its own. Record is the law as published; later amendments (Ley 2340/2003, 5427/2015, 6366/2019, 6624/2020) are separate laws on BACN and are not merged into the stored text, so a reader must apply them separately. Spanish only: the BACN page serves no Guaraní text, and no government English text was found on the BACN law page or the MADES laws list.

title: Decreto N° 3369/2025, por el cual se reglamenta la Ley N° 7190/2023 De los Créditos de Carbono
evidence: MADES news page (opened 2026-11-03): "El presidente de la República, Santiago Peña, firmó este martes 18 de febrero, en una ceremonia en Mburuvicha Róga, el Decreto que reglamenta Ley N° 7190/23 «De los Créditos de Carbono»". The page gives the signing date, not a commencement date, and does not print the decree number; the number 3369/2025 comes from MADES documents that cite it (https://www.mades.gov.py/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/PDF-Documento-orientativo-de-la-Republica-del-Paraguay-para-la-COP30.pdf, "su Decreto Reglamentario N° 3369/2025").
notes: Link only: no official page that serves the decree text could be opened. The MADES decree list (https://www.mades.gov.py/decretos) does not include it; the Gaceta Oficial (https://www.gacetaoficial.gov.py) did not answer from the cloud address; the Presidency site did not answer either. Third-party copies exist (law-firm and association sites) and are not used. Per the press page the decree creates the Dirección de Mercados de Carbono and the Registro de Créditos de Carbono. in_force is null because no opened official page states a commencement date or publication date.
